articles.summary: In early trading on Thursday, the rupee gained 11 paise against the US dollar, reaching 95.17. Observers are now focused on upcoming economic data, especially regarding inflation and potential rate adjustments. Notably, Foreign Institutional Investors have been actively purchasing Indian equities, reflecting a positive market outlook.
